sources.title: kingjones777/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-ROCmFP4-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 4-bit ROCmFP4 quantization of JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct, built for AMD gfx1151 (Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 / Strix Halo), with the LM head and token embeddings held at Q6_K.

sources.title: kingjones777/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-ROCmFPX-Q8_0-AGENT-GGUF ...
sources.snippet: Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct — ROCmFPX 8-bit AGENT GGUF An 8-bit ROCmFPX quantization for AMD gfx1151 (Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 / Strix Halo), quantized from BF16 GGUF (24,311,968,416 B) — a lossless source, byte-verified against the upstream blob.

sources.title: Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct GGUF Quantization & Evaluation
sources.snippet: Scripts and tools for converting JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct to GGUF format with quantization (Q8_0 and Q4_K_M), plus evaluation scripts for reproducing published benchmarks locally.
